description: enables the default permissions. Updater is granted by least privilege: allow-check only. The updater:default set would also grant download and install, which no code path uses yet (the update UI and its business-safety gating are a separate, later task). Whoever adds the install flow must add updater:allow-download-and-install in that same change, deliberately. NOTE: this file is strict JSON and the Tauri capability parser rejects comments, so the rationale lives in this description.
